name: grill
description: Deep codebase interrogation — multi-angle architecture review that forces rigorous, actionable analysis

interface.shortDescription: Multi-angle codebase interrogation with 6 specialized analysis skills
interface.longDescription: Use Grill to interrogate a codebase from 6 angles in parallel — architecture, error handling, security, testing, edge cases, and recon. Five review styles (including Paranoid Mode) and 8 add-on pressure tests produce a single synthesized report with severity-tagged findings, concrete evidence, and an ordered fixing plan.
defaultPrompt: Run a grill review on this codebase.
Use $grill-roast to interrogate this repo from multiple angles.
